matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 211-220 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. Repeated or near-matching rows remain distinct, including Albert J Hoffarth/Hoffman; the two Elaine V Hogeland rows; the two Pauline C Hollingsworth rows; Hillery E/no-initial Holt; Mary C/R Holtz; Hebert/Herbert M Hooker; John L/E Hoover; the two Robert E Hoover rows; Veron G Hopper/Vernon G Hoppers; Robert T/P Hotaling; Nancy A/Nancy Adama M House; Edwin J/S Hubbell; the two Eugene A Hubbell rows; and Robert L Hudgens/Hudgins. The review preserves truncated printed forms, literal capitalization such as JaNE G Horton, foreign and service notes, out-of-sequence boxes and locations, and column shifts exactly as printed. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
